title: Uhura: A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Question Answering and Truthfulness in Low-Resource African Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating scientific knowledge and truthfulness (misconceptions/factual accuracy) across low-resource languages. While it includes a section on 'Cultural Bias' and an appendix on 'Ethical Considerations', these focus on representational bias and research methodology rather than benchmarking religious, theological, or specific moral/ethical frameworks.
